parsed.post: Kept latest run (val_bpb 1.034211) using valid shards 0-9. This confirms that the trend of reducing batch size to increase step count is working. Next, I'll experiment with increasing the learning rate slightly to see if we can optimize convergence with the smaller batch size.
parsed.description: Halving batch size to 262144 to increase optimizer steps, and increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.08 to compensate for the smaller batch size.
